ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (central fluke) to low-intensity black pixels (trailing edge and lateral tips).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black band along the trailing edge; high-density black pigmentation at lateral tips; sparse black speckling concentrated in the lower-central region near the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical U-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is most pronounced on the outer thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and annular gray-scale clusters (barnacle scars) distributed across the upper-left and upper-right fluke surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, short-stroke diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible in the lower-right quadrant of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive yellowish-brown calcified barnacle clusters localized on the far-right lateral tip; irregular, jagged trailing edge on the far-left tip indicating minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark pigmentation focal point located at the base of the median notch.
